name: geometry-map-truth-assisted-constrained-corrections
status: Root-approved final A safety-gate amendment; first-three-shot bit parity and unchanged native score required before one full-70 retry, no model fit
amendment_reason: The unchanged v6 forward TPS+taper stopped on source shot index 7 frame 6 because the arbitrary Newton finite-difference detJ>0.2 cutoff rejected one stable positive local derivative 0.185179. Dense 4x forward-grid detJ minimum was 0.163817 with zero negative points, positive fixed-connectivity triangle areas, exact boundary identity, physical min singular value 0.15189 and maximum condition 7.10. Read-only same-map Newton with det>0 converged in four steps, no out-of-grid points and unchanged residual tolerance. Replace only the safety validation by positive dense-grid/triangle orientation and physical condition<=10; keep every forward-map and inverse-solving operation unchanged. This is the final gate amendment; stop if another distinct failure occurs.
question: Can these two fixed truth-assisted map-space correction families move contour geometry or interior li enough to justify later input-only model research?
scope: Constrained mechanism gate only, not an upper bound over every geometry correction. The true psi of labeled DIII-D training-corpus shots may determine a correction, but no true values or corrected arrays may enter a public submission or deployable predictor.

input.source_dtype: float32 for psirz, q95 and betaN
input.source_of_truth: Stored efit_psirz on these labeled training-corpus shots only; oracle targets are scorer-derived LCFS and f_j(psi_true), not stored scalar labels

smoke.selection_rule: First three files in the pinned 70-shot score order, without looking at oracle outcomes
smoke.purpose: Correctness/topology/finite-map gate only; pooled S on three shots is not a quality estimate. Classify failure as numerical infeasibility of this fixed construction or a valid-map score outcome.
smoke.execution_gate: Only after root reviews and accepts this spec and the math; no full-70 pass or fitting at this stage

common_rules.submitted_scalars: q95 and betaN must be bit-identical float32 arrays from the input prediction
common_rules.map_dtype: finite float32 after one final cast; no float16 precision confound
common_rules.reference_code: Use the scorer's own frozen extract_lcfs, derive_frame and internal_inductance on true and predicted maps. Never replace a native derived output directly.
common_rules.scoring: Rescore actual corrected psi arrays through the unmodified frozen local_score.py on exactly the same ordered filenames as the original control, one native pass per arm
common_rules.failures: A missing/degenerate contour, nonfinite output, invalid topology or shape mismatch raises with shot and frame; never silently skip a frame or substitute the true map. Record a validity exception as numerical infeasibility, not evidence that the geometry mechanism is useless.

A_contour_warp.hypothesis: This one smooth spatial warp family can align predicted and true LCFS contours and move D_LCFS/shape without replacing the full flux map; its failure does not refute other warp families
A_contour_warp.contours: Extract scorer-native 512-point C_pred and C_true on every frame. Reject missing, nonsimple or oppositely oriented geometry unless true contour reversal restores common orientation.
A_contour_warp.correspondence: Match equal-arclength samples by the single cyclic shift minimizing summed squared physical (R,Z) displacement; break ties by the lowest shift. No star-shaped or radial-contour assumption.
A_contour_warp.warp: Use 64 uniformly spaced matched boundary controls, the predicted magnetic-axis anchor with zero displacement and 16 fixed grid-edge anchors (four corners plus 1/4, 1/2 and 3/4 along every edge) with zero displacement. Fit a 2-D thin-plate-spline RBF raw displacement u_raw in unit-normalized grid coordinates, smoothing=0.0001, degree=1. Let W(x)=x+T(x)*u_raw(x) map predicted coordinates to true-contour coordinates. The taper acts on the displacement field before computing the Jacobian and inverse, never on the flux map.
A_contour_warp.boundary_taper: For every point x=(R,Z), let d_min be the minimum physical distance of any C_pred point to any of the four rectangular grid edges and m=0.5*d_min>0. Define h(t)=0 for t<=0, 3t^2-2t^3 for 0<t<1, and 1 for t>=1. T(x)=h((R-Rmin)/m)*h((Rmax-R)/m)*h((Z-Zmin)/m)*h((Zmax-Z)/m). Require T=0 on every grid-edge pixel, and T=1 at all predicted contour controls and the predicted magnetic axis; any failure is numerical infeasibility. This leaves the LCFS displacement at full strength while enforcing zero displacement on the whole grid boundary.
A_contour_warp.resampling: Solve W(x_source)=x_output from the direct target-grid initializer by the UNCHANGED vectorized damped Newton method, not Delaunay. Hold every grid-boundary inverse point exactly at its target because boundary taper makes W(x)=x there. Use centered finite-difference Jacobian step 0.00001 in normalized coordinates, per-point backtracking alpha=1,1/2,...,1/512 accepting only in-grid strict residual decreases, and at most 12 Newton steps. The only gate change is positive Jacobian determinant and physical condition<=10 instead of det>0.2; still reject nonfinite/singular Jacobian, unavailable decreasing step, any out-of-grid inverse, or max forward-after-inverse residual above the SAME frozen tolerance 0.00001 of the smaller grid spacing. Bilinearly sample original psi with bounds_error=True and cast once to float32. No clipping/fallback.
A_contour_warp.validity: Require boundary controls unique, both closed contours simple, maximum matched displacement <= 4 grid diagonals, taper invariants above and exact boundary identity. On the unchanged forward W, require positive signed area for every triangle of the fixed 65x65 grid connectivity, positive detJ on every 4x-dense 257x257 physical grid point, and maximum physical Jacobian condition<=10. Newton finite-difference Jacobian must remain positive and physical condition<=10 at each active iterate; remove only the old det>0.2 cutoff. Retain the same inverse residual tolerance, in-grid decreasing-step/backtracking/finite checks and bilinear bounds_error sampling. No clipping, extrapolation or skipped frame. Any violation fails that frame and the run.
A_contour_warp.truth_used: Only C_true; no true interior psi values, li target, stored q95 or betaN
A_contour_warp.report: Native S, R2_psi, D_LCFS, all seven consistency R2, LCFS failures and warp validity; no claim of a deployable predictor

B_interior_li_remap.hypothesis: This nine-point nonlinear monotone remap family can change li through |grad psi| while preserving the axis and LCFS level sets in the continuum; its failure does not refute other profile corrections
B_interior_li_remap.normalization: With scorer sign s and predicted axis/LCFS, phi=s*psi, u=(phi_axis-phi)/(phi_axis-phi_sep). phi_sep is the median bilinear phi sample on the scorer-extracted predicted contour; require positive axis-to-separatrix span, all finite contour samples and max deviation from the median <=0.001 of that span.
B_interior_li_remap.family: For 0<=u<=1 use g_a(u)=u+a*u^2*(1-u)^2; outside this interval use g_a(u)=u. Construct phi_new=phi_axis-(phi_axis-phi_sep)*g_a(u), psi_new=s*phi_new. This fixes g(0)=0, g(1)=1 and endpoint first derivatives. On the fixed candidate grid |a|<=2, the analytic minimum derivative is >0.615.
B_interior_li_remap.oracle_choice: Per frame, evaluate scorer-native internal_inductance on each candidate map using the original predicted contour. Choose the candidate with minimum absolute error to scorer-derived li(psi_true); ties choose smallest |a| then lowest a. This is a truth-assisted ceiling, not a deployable parameter.
B_interior_li_remap.validity: Require all nine maps finite float32, strict monotonicity on [0,1], the a=0 map bit-exact with the source, same O-point within 0.01 grid spacing, no new LCFS extraction failure and symmetric Hausdorff distance from the original predicted contour <=0.1 of the smaller grid spacing. A violation fails that frame and the smoke.
B_interior_li_remap.truth_used: Only scorer-derived li(psi_true); no true contour alignment or true map replacement
B_interior_li_remap.report: Native S, li R2, R2_psi, D_LCFS and every other consistency R2; report fraction of frames whose true li lies outside the nine-candidate li range

arithmetic_headroom.source: results/historical_eleven_blocks_20260922.json for local terms; official Codabench details for public 941038
arithmetic_headroom.interpretation: These are true arithmetic headroom bounds for individually perfect metric terms, not achievable gains or bounds on public improvement from the fixed corrections. Geometry corrections can hurt R2_psi and other terms.

after_smoke_decision.A: No full-70 correction unless all 578 smoke frames pass topology/inverse/finite checks. If a later full-70 valid-map net Delta S is below the current public third-place gap, deprioritize investment in this exact warp family; local and public folds are different, so this is not an impossibility theorem.
after_smoke_decision.B: No full-70 correction unless all smoke frames preserve contour/axis constraints and a=0 exact bits. The local li-only arithmetic headroom is below the current public gap, but public-fold improvement cannot be bounded by local Delta S. Treat this exact family as secondary unless later full-70 li contribution reaches at least 0.000395 S (half local li headroom) with positive net S.
after_smoke_decision.model_training: Never from this mechanism smoke; any deployable input-only learner would require a separate pre-registered paired-salt confirmation
after_smoke_decision.cost_estimate: The measured full-70 native scorer takes about 98 seconds at CPU4 per arm; first-three-shot smoke covers 578 frames and may still pay process-start overhead. Nine li functional evaluations per frame plus TPS solves can dominate map construction; measure smoke wall before budgeting a full-70 oracle. No GPU fit is part of this stage.
